Check out Card Clash by Rovatics — fast top-trumps card battles you can play with friends or bots! https://www.rovatics.com/games.html
Fast top-trumps battles for 2–4 players. Cricket stars, wrestlers and robots — pick a deck, choose how many cards each, and play.
Look at your top card and choose the stat you think will beat everyone. The highest value wins every card on the table.
Create a room and share the 5-letter code to play online — or jump straight into a game against bots, even without internet.
Once per game, double the stakes. Win and every loser pays an extra card — lose and it costs you. Last player with cards wins!

Card Clash is a fast top-trumps card battle. Each player is dealt part of the deck and can only see their top card. The player whose turn it is picks a stat; everyone reveals, and the highest value takes every card on the table. Keep winning cards until you hold the whole deck.

• Three big decks: Cricket Stars, Wrestling Slam and Rovatics Bots — over 680 characters • Choose 6 to 50 cards each, with Quick, Standard or Marathon matches • 2–4 players — bots offline, or friends online with a room code • ⚡ Power Play: double the stakes, once per game • A fanfare and buzz when it is your turn, celebrations when you win • Free, with no ads and no account

1. Tap “Play vs bots”, or create a room and share the code.
2. When it is your turn, tap the stat on your card you think is strongest.
3. Everyone reveals — the highest value wins all the cards.
4. Lose all your cards and you are out. The last player with cards wins.

• Internet — used only for online rooms. Games against bots work without it.
• No camera, microphone, location, contacts or storage access.
• No account, no ads and no analytics.
• Your display name, win record and sound setting are saved on this device only. In an online room your name and moves are shared with the other players; connections are set up through the public PeerJS service.
All characters are fictional and every statistic is invented. Some names are playful parodies. Card Clash is not affiliated with or endorsed by any real player, team or organisation.
